title: The error-report scrub compiles a 51k-character pattern on first use (about a third of a second), on the browser's main thread
evidence: Found 2026-11-25 while closing H70: METRIC_THEN_VALUE_RE in packages/health-core/src/scrub-vocabulary.ts has a source of 51,037 characters. Built at import; V8 compiles it on first use and tiers it up to native code on a later call, which took 317 ms in Node in one measurement. In the browser that cost lands on the main thread. Remedy: compile on the first event, not at import. (H401)
